jobs.title: Internship on Power Systems of the Future 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join a dynamic research team shaping the future of energy systems. You will explore how renewable energy, smart grids, and sector coupling are transforming power systems worldwide. This 6 months internship offers a unique chance to contribute to next-generation solutions while developing your skills in a supportive and flexible environment. You'll work closely with experts across business units and gain valuable insights into innovation and sustainability. How you'll make an impact Perform market analysis on renewables and smart grid topics Derive system and product requirements based on the market analysis Define high-level functional architectures for future solutions Simulate future energy scenarios and technologies Model emerging technologies across power system levels (e.g. DC grids, electro-mobility, energy storage, electrolyzes and fuel cells, demand response, etc.) Develop, maintain and document new techno-economic assessment tools for simulating behavior of energy systems on different time scale Build future energy scenarios on regional and global scales Your background Currently pursuing a M.S. degree in electrical engineering or completed a similar M.S. degree less than 12 months ago Familiar with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi) integrated into simulation workflows developed in MATLAB and Python Experience with renewable energy and smart grid technologies, solutions, and concepts, combined with proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar Excellent communicator in English, both in writing and speaking Background in the following power system topics: steady-state and dynamic stability analysis and modeling, fault analysis and power system protection, energy and ancillary service markets Self-starter with a strong willingness to learn, capable of working independently while also being a reliable and collaborative team player More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a un team di ricerca dinamico che modella il futuro dei sistemi energetici. Scoprirete come le energie rinnovabili, le reti intelligenti e l'accoppiamento del settore stanno trasformando i sistemi di energia in tutto il mondo. Questo tirocinio di 6 mesi offre la possibilità unica di contribuire a soluzioni di nuova generazione, sviluppando le vostre competenze in un ambiente flessibile e di supporto. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con esperti di business unit e ottenere preziose informazioni sull'innovazione e la sostenibilità. Eseguire l'analisi del mercato sulle energie rinnovabili e sugli argomenti della rete intelligente Requisiti del sistema e del prodotto basati sull'analisi di mercato Definire architetture funzionali di alto livello per le soluzioni future Simulano scenari energetici futuri e tecnologie Modello tecnologie emergenti attraverso i livelli del sistema di potenza (ad esempio griglie DC, elettro-mobilità, stoccaggio di energia, elettrolizza e celle a combustibile, risposta della domanda, ecc.) Sviluppare, mantenere e documentare nuovi strumenti di valutazione tecno-economica per simulare il comportamento dei sistemi energetici su scala temporale diversa Il tuo background Attualmente persegue un M.S. in ingegneria elettrica o ha completato un simile grado di M.S. inferiore a 12 mesi fa Familiare con i risolutori di ottimizzazione (ad esempio, Gurobi) integrato in flussi di lavoro di simulazione sviluppati in MATLAB e Python Experience con le tecnologie, le soluzioni, i concetti, insieme con la competenza in strumenti di analisi del sistema di potenza come PowerFactory, PSCAD, o simile comunicatore stabile in inglese,
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.

Nehmen Sie an einem dynamischen Forschungsteam teil, das die Zukunft der Energiesysteme prägt. Sie werden erforschen, wie erneuerbare Energien, intelligente Netze und Branchenkopplung Energiesysteme weltweit transformieren. Dieses 6 Monate Praktikum bietet eine einzigartige Chance, zu Lösungen der nächsten Generation beizutragen und Ihre Fähigkeiten in einer unterstützenden und flexiblen Umgebung zu entwickeln. Sie arbeiten eng mit Experten über Business Units zusammen und gewinnen wertvolle Einblicke in Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Marktanalyse auf Erneuerbare und intelligente Netzthemen Ableitende System- und Produktanforderungen basierend auf der Marktanalyse Definieren Sie hochrangige Funktionsarchitekturen für zukünftige Lösungen Simulieren Sie zukünftige Energieszenarien und Technologien Modell Schwellentechnologien über Leistungsebenen (z.B. DC-Netze, Elektromobilität, Energiespeicher, Elektrolyse und Brennstoffzellen, Anforderungsreaktion usw.) Gurobi) integriert in Simulations-Workflows entwickelt in MATLAB und Python Experience mit erneuerbaren Energie- und Smart-Grid-Technologien, Lösungen und Konzepte, kombiniert mit Effizienz in Power-System-Analyse-Tools wie PowerFactory, PSCAD oder ähnlich

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion Joignez-vous à une équipe de recherche dynamique qui façonne l'avenir des systèmes énergétiques. Vous explorerez comment les énergies renouvelables, les réseaux intelligents et le couplage sectoriel transforment les systèmes électriques dans le monde entier. Ce stage de 6 mois offre une chance unique de contribuer aux solutions de nouvelle génération tout en développant vos compétences dans un environnement solidaire et flexible. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des experts de tous les secteurs d'activité et vous aurez des idées précieuses sur l'innovation et la durabilité. Réalisez une analyse de marché sur les énergies renouvelables et les réseaux intelligents.Exigences en matière de systèmes dérivés et de produits basées sur l'analyse de marché Définir des architectures fonctionnelles de haut niveau pour des solutions futures Simuler les scénarios et les technologies énergétiques futures Modéliser les technologies émergentes à tous les niveaux du système d'alimentation (p. ex. réseaux à courant continu, électromobilité, stockage de l'énergie, électrolyses et piles à combustible, réponse à la demande, etc.) Élaborer, tenir à jour et documenter de nouveaux outils d'évaluation technico-économique permettant de simuler le comportement des systèmes énergétiques à différentes échelles de temps. Vos antécédents Actuellement en cours de M.S. en génie électrique ou terminé un degré M.S similaire il y a moins de 12 mois Familiarisez-vous avec des résolveurs d'optimisation (p. ex., Gurobi) intégrés dans des workflows de simulation développés en MATLAB et Python Expérience avec des technologies, des solutions et des concepts d'énergie renouvelable et de réseau intelligent, combinés avec la compétence dans les outils d'analyse de système d'alimentation tels que PowerFactory, CPSAD, ou similaire Excellent communicateur en anglais, à la fois en écriture et en discours Contexte dans les sujets suivants du système d'alimentation : analyse et modélisation de stabilité stable et dynamique, analyse des défaillances et protection du système d'alimentation électrique, marchés de l'énergie et des services auxiliaires Auto-démarrage avec une forte volonté d'apprendre, capable de travailler de façon indépendante, tout en étant un joueur d'équipe fiable et collaborative Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et fortement axée sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.title: Procurement Team Lead 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine dynamische und erfahrene Führungskraft für den Einkauf, die unser engagiertes Service-Team bei Hitachi, Ltd. verstärkt, wo Geschwindigkeit und Qualität von größter Bedeutung sind. In dieser Schlüsselposition führen Sie strategische Einkaufsinitiativen, optimieren die Beschaffungsprozesse und leiten ein talentiertes Team von etwa 12 Einkaufsexperten. Ihre Expertise sorgt für eine schnelle und kosteneffiziente Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen, während Sie höchste Qualitätsstandards wahren und langfristige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu Lieferanten fördern. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. Die Anwendung der Critical-Path-Methode zur Sicherstellung pünktlicher Beschaffungsprozesse und zur Minimierung von Lieferverzögerungen gehört zu Ihren Kernaufgaben. Sie gewährleisten durchgängige Exzellenz im gesamten Einkaufsprozess – von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zur Zahlung – und sorgen für klare Abläufe sowie maximale Transparenz. Sie definieren und steuern die Lieferanten-Segmentierung und entwickeln zielgerichtete Beschaffungsstrategien. Zudem verantworten Sie die Auswahl, Qualifizierung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Durch den Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften auf Führungsebene und die Etablierung robuster Lieferantenmanagement-Systeme mit KPIs, Scorecards, regelmässigen Reviews und Eskalationsprozessen sichern Sie die nachhaltige Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Lieferantennetzwerks. Sie arbeiten eng mit abteilungsübergreifenden Teams wie Materialplanung, Engineering, Qualität und Controlling zusammen, um den Einkauf optimal auf die Unternehmensanforderungen abzustimmen. Sie steuern einkaufsbezogene Risiken, einschließlich Lieferkettenstörungen, Preisschwankungen und Compliance-Themen. Das bringen Sie mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Einkauf oder Supply Chain Management oder mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich. Nachweisbare Erfolge im strategischen Einkauf, in Verhandlungen und im Lieferanten- oder Kundenmanagement sind von Vorteil. Sehr gutes Verständnis von Einkaufsprozessen, Vertragsrecht und Prinzipien der Lieferkette. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsvermögen. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Einkauf-Software (z.B. SAP Ariba) und Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem schnelllebigen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu managen. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Fertigung, Technologie oder Industrie ist sehr wünschenswert. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungen zu optimieren und schaffen eine Umgebung, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

Possibilità Siamo alla ricerca di un esecutivo dinamico ed esperto per l'acquisto che rafforza il nostro team di assistenza dedicato a Hitachi, Ltd., dove velocità e qualità sono della massima importanza. In questa posizione chiave, conduci iniziative di acquisto strategiche, ottimizza i processi di approvvigionamento e gestisci un team di talento di circa 12 esperti di shopping. La vostra esperienza garantisce un approvvigionamento rapido e conveniente di beni e servizi, mantenendo al contempo i più elevati standard di qualità e promuovendo rapporti di partnership a lungo termine con i fornitori. Questo ti permette di assumere la leadership, la promozione e l'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro team di acquisto e creare una cultura aziendale orientata alle prestazioni e responsabile. Sviluppano e implementano concetti di approvvigionamento innovativi secondo la nostra strategia di servizio. In questo modo, ponete particolare attenzione alla consegna tempestiva, al miglioramento continuo della qualità, al miglioramento dell'efficienza della supply chain e alla riduzione dei costi sostenibile. L'applicazione del metodo Critical-Path per garantire i processi di approvvigionamento tempestivo e per ridurre al minimo i ritardi di consegna è uno dei vostri compiti principali. Garantiscono un'eccellenza costante in tutto il processo di acquisto – dalla determinazione della domanda al pagamento – e garantiscono processi chiari e massima trasparenza. Definiscono e controllano la segmentazione dei fornitori e sviluppano strategie di approvvigionamento mirate. Inoltre, sei responsabile per la selezione, la qualificazione e le trattative contrattuali con i fornitori. Con la costruzione di partnership strategiche a livello di leadership e la creazione di sistemi di gestione dei fornitori robusti con KPI, schede di punteggio, recensioni regolari e processi di escalation, è possibile garantire le prestazioni sostenibili della nostra rete di fornitori. Lavorano a stretto contatto con team interdipartimentali come la pianificazione dei materiali, l'ingegneria, la qualità e il controllo, al fine di ottimizzare l'acquisto alle esigenze aziendali. Essi controllano i rischi legati all'acquisto, tra cui interruzioni della supply chain, fluttuazioni dei prezzi e problemi di conformità. Questo ti porta a studi completi nel campo della gestione della supply chain, della gestione aziendale, dell'ingegneria o della formazione comparabile con esperienza professionale rilevante. Almeno 5 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'acquisto o nella gestione della supply chain o almeno 3 anni di esperienza di leadership in un'area collegata. I successi rilevabili nell'acquisto strategico, nei negoziati e nella gestione del fornitore o del cliente sono vantaggiosi. Ottima comprensione dei processi di acquisto, diritto contrattuale e principi della catena di fornitura. Competenze analitiche impressionate e problem-solving e decision-making. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e competenze interpersonali. Ottima conoscenza del software di acquisto (ad esempio SAP Ariba) e Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel. Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente internazionale veloce e gestire più priorità. L'esperienza nella produzione, nella tecnologia o nell'industria è molto auspicabile. I nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili consentono di ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Possibility We are looking for a dynamic and experienced executive for purchasing that strengthens our dedicated service team at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are of the utmost importance. In this key position, you conduct strategic purchasing initiatives, optimize procurement processes and run a talented team of around 12 shopping experts. Your expertise ensures a fast and cost-effective procurement of goods and services while maintaining the highest quality standards and promoting long-term, partnership relationships with suppliers. This allows you to take over the leadership, promotion and further development of our purchasing team and create a performance-oriented and responsible corporate culture. They develop and implement innovative procurement concepts in accordance with our service strategy. In doing so, you place particular emphasis on timely delivery, continuous quality improvement, efficiency improvement in the supply chain and sustainable cost reduction. The application of the Critical-Path method to ensure timely procurement processes and to minimize delivery delays is one of your core tasks. They ensure consistent excellence throughout the entire purchasing process – from demand determination to payment – and ensure clear processes and maximum transparency. They define and control supplier segmentation and develop targeted procurement strategies. In addition, you are responsible for the selection, qualification and contract negotiations with suppliers. By building strategic partnerships at leadership level and establishing robust supplier management systems with KPIs, scorecards, regular reviews and escalation processes, you can ensure the sustainable performance of our supplier network. They work closely with cross-departmental teams such as material planning, engineering, quality and controlling, in order to optimally tune the purchase to the corporate requirements. They control purchase-related risks, including supply chain disruptions, price fluctuations and compliance issues. This brings you with completed studies in the field of supply chain management, business management, engineering or comparable training with relevant professional experience. At least 5 years of relevant experience in purchasing or supply chain management or at least 3 years of leadership experience in a related area. Detectable successes in strategic purchasing, in negotiations and in supplier or customer management are advantageous. Very good understanding of purchasing processes, contract law and principles of the supply chain. Impressed analytical skills as well as problem-solving and decision-making. Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Very good knowledge of purchasing software (e.g. SAP Ariba) and Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment and manage multiple priorities. Experience in manufacturing, technology or industry is very desirable. Our flexible work models help you to optimize personal and business performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La possibilité Nous recherchons un cadre dynamique et expérimenté pour l'achat qui renforce notre équipe de service dédiée à Hitachi, Ltd., où la vitesse et la qualité sont de la plus haute importance. Dans cette position clé, vous réalisez des initiatives d'achat stratégiques, optimisez les processus d'approvisionnement et dirigez une équipe talentueuse d'environ 12 experts en achats. Votre expertise assure un achat rapide et rentable de biens et de services tout en maintenant les normes de qualité les plus élevées et en favorisant des relations de partenariat à long terme avec les fournisseurs. Cela vous permet de prendre en charge le leadership, la promotion et le développement de notre équipe d'achat et de créer une culture d'entreprise axée sur le rendement et responsable. Ils élaborent et mettent en oeuvre des concepts d'approvisionnement novateurs conformément à notre stratégie de service. Ce faisant, vous insistez particulièrement sur la livraison en temps opportun, l'amélioration continue de la qualité, l'amélioration de l'efficacité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la réduction durable des coûts. L'application de la méthode Critical-Path pour assurer des processus d'approvisionnement en temps opportun et pour minimiser les retards de livraison est l'une de vos tâches principales. jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur industriel pour la production de SIG 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale altamente motivato con l'attenzione su Automazione e Robotica per ottimizzare e migliorare l'efficienza delle nostre linee di produzione Interruttore Isolato Gas (GIS). Questo ruolo comporta l'applicazione di principi di ingegneria industriale, tecnologie di automazione e soluzioni robotiche per migliorare i processi produttivi, ridurre i rifiuti e migliorare la produttività. I laureati motivati con una forte attenzione all'automazione e alla robotica sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare.

Mansioni
- Analizzare i layout delle linee di produzione GIS attuali, i flussi di lavoro e le procedure operative per identificare le aree per il miglioramento dell'efficienza, dei costi e della qualità, con un focus sul potenziale di automazione
- Progettazione e realizzazione di processi produttivi ottimizzati, tra cui nuove metodologie, concetti di automazione, applicazioni robotiche, utilizzo di attrezzature e flusso di materiale
- Condurre gli studi di tempo e di movimento, la mappatura dei processi e l'analisi del flusso di valore per identificare i colli di bottiglia ed eliminare le attività non a valore aggiunto
- Sviluppare e implementare procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni di lavoro per il montaggio e il test GIS, compresi i processi automatizzati e assistiti da robot
- Collaborare con altri ingegneri industriali, responsabili della produzione, ingegneri di design, team di implementazione di qualità e nuovi prodotti
- Condurre e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, tra cui i progetti Lean Manufacturing e Six Sigma, sfruttando le tecnologie di digitalizzazione e automazione
- Valutare, specificare e implementare nuove tecnologie, tra cui robotica (ad esempio cobot), sistemi automatizzati e soluzioni di produzione intelligenti per l'ambiente di produzione GIS

Requisiti
- Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Robotica, Ingegneria industriale, Ingegneria manifatturiera, o un campo correlato
- L'esperienza professionale iniziale nell'ingegneria industriale all'interno di un ambiente di produzione è preferita
- Esperienza iniziale o comprovata con l'automazione industriale e/o l'integrazione robotica (ad esempio, celle robotiche, cobot, sistemi automatizzati di gestione dei materiali)
- Forte sfondo nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, principi di produzione magra e metodologie di miglioramento continuo (ad esempio, Kaizen, Six Sigma)
- Proficienza negli strumenti di analisi dei processi (ad esempio, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo, controllo dei processi statistici)
- Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi team e gestire più progetti contemporaneamente
- La familiarità con i processi di produzione GIS o la produzione di apparecchiature elettriche complesse simili è altamente auspicabile
- Fluente commerciale in inglese e tedesco

Cosa?
- Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Contatto
Nessuna informazione di contatto fornita.
descriptionByLocale.en:
## L'opportunità
We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply.

## Mansioni
- Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential
- Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow
- Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities
- Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes
- Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team
- Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies
- Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment

## Requisiti
- Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field
- Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred
- Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems)
- Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma)
- Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control)
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable
- Business fluent in English and German

## Cosa offriamo
- Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

## Contatto
No contact information provided.
descriptionByLocale.de:
L'opportunità
Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Industrieingenieur mit Fokus auf Automatisierung und Robotik, um die Effizienz unserer Gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) zu optimieren und zu verbessern. Diese Rolle besteht darin, industrielle Technikprinzipien sowie Automatisierungstechnologien und Robotiklösungen anzuwenden, um Fertigungsprozesse zu verbessern, Abfall zu reduzieren und die Produktivität zu verbessern. Motivierte Absolventen mit einem starken Fokus auf Automatisierung und Robotik werden ebenfalls gefördert.

Mansion
- Analyse aktueller GIS-Produktionslinienlayouts, Workflows und Betriebsabläufe, um Bereiche zur Verbesserung von Effizienz, Kosten und Qualität zu identifizieren, mit dem Schwerpunkt Automatisierungspotenzial
- Entwicklung und Implementierung optimierter Produktionsprozesse, einschließlich neuer Methoden, Automatisierungskonzepte, Roboteranwendungen, Auslastung und Materialfluss
- Durchführung von Zeit- und Bewegungsstudien, Prozesskartierungen und Wertstromanalysen, um Engpässe zu identifizieren und nicht-wertgebundene Aktivitäten zu beseitigen
- Entwicklung und Implementierung von Standard-Betriebsverfahren (SOPs) und Arbeitsanleitungen für GIS-Montage und -Tests, einschließlich automatisierter und robotergestützter Prozesse
- Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Industrieingenieuren, Produktionsleitern, Design-Ingenieuren, Qualität und neue Produkt-Implementierung Team
- Führen Sie und nehmen Sie an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen teil, darunter Lean Manufacturing und Six Sigma Projekte, die Digitalisierung und Automatisierungstechnologien nutzen
- Neue Technologien wie Robotik (z.B. Cobots), automatisierte Systeme und intelligente Fertigungslösungen für die GIS-Produktionsumgebung evaluieren, definieren und implementieren

Voraussetzungen
- Masterstudium Automatisierungstechnik, Robotik, Industrietechnik, Fertigungstechnik oder ein verwandten Bereich
- Erste Berufserfahrung in der Industrietechnik in einer Fertigungsumgebung wird bevorzugt
- Erste oder bewährte Erfahrung mit der industriellen Automatisierung und/oder Robotik-Integration (z.B. Roboterzellen, Cobots, automatisierte Materialhandlingsysteme)
- Starker Hintergrund bei Prozessoptimierung, schlanken Fertigungsprinzipien und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden (z.B. Kaizen, Six Sigma)
- Effizienz in Prozessanalyse-Tools (z.B. Wertstrom-Mapping, Zeitstudien, statistische Prozesssteuerung)
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit verschiedenen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten
- Vertraulichkeit mit GIS-Produktionsprozessen oder ähnliche komplexe elektrische Geräteherstellung ist sehr wünschenswert
- Business fließend auf Englisch und Deutsch

Cosa offriamo
- Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

Nous recherchons un ingénieur industriel hautement motivé, axé sur l'automatisation et la robotique, afin d'optimiser et d'améliorer l'efficacité de nos lignes de production GIS. Ce rôle consiste à appliquer les principes de l'ingénierie industrielle ainsi que les technologies d'automatisation et les solutions robotiques pour améliorer les processus de fabrication, réduire les déchets et améliorer la productivité. Les diplômés motivés qui mettent l'accent sur l'automatisation et la robotique sont également encouragés à postuler.

Mansioni
- Analyser les schémas actuels de la chaîne de production du SIG, les flux de travail et les procédures opérationnelles pour identifier les domaines à améliorer en termes d'efficacité, de coûts et de qualité, en mettant l'accent sur le potentiel d'automatisation

- Collaborer avec d'autres ingénieurs industriels, gestionnaires de production, ingénieurs de conception, qualité et nouvelle équipe de mise en œuvre de produits
- Diriger et participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue, y compris des projets Lean Manufacturing et Six Sigma, en tirant parti des technologies de numérisation et d'automatisation

- Compétence en outils d ' analyse des processus (par exemple, cartographie des flux de valeurs, études de temps, contrôle des processus statistiques)

With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power electronics and\/or control technology Initial professional experience (2–3 years) in projects, tenders, contract management or a technical role with exposure to project or customer-facing work, with the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

jobs.title: Teamleiter Instandhaltung 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In unserem Profit Center in Wettingen produzieren und offerieren wir innovative, zuverlässige und sichere Überspannungsschutzlösungen für die Segmente Stromerzeugung\/-verteilung sowie Railway und Industrie. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit mit hochwertigen Technologien zu unterstützen und nachhaltige Mehrwerte zu schaffen. Dies gelingt durch die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kerntechnologien sowie durch die stetige Verbesserung unserer Prozesse – getragen von offener Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Teamgeist. Als Teamleiter Instandhaltung übernimmst du eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle und führst ein engagiertes Team von sechs Mitarbeitenden. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für die zuverlässige Funktion aller Produktionsanlagen und technischen Systeme in einer hochautomatisierten Prozessfertigung. jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Functional Lead Secondary Engineering Standardization Team 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation isothermes. Pour notre unité d'affaires Produits haute tension, nous recherchons un responsable fonctionnel de l'équipe de normalisation en génie secondaire. Vos antécédents Expérience en génie électrique Capacité démontrée de diriger avec succès, soit en poste de direction, soit dans des projets complexes et exigeants Expérience solide en génie des équipements secondaires (LCC) comme génie secondaire PM Expérience des outils correspondants utilisés pour la préparation en génie secondaire pour assumer le rôle de leadership fonctionnel au sein d'une équipe. jobs.title: Internship in Low-Code Development 80 - 100% (f/m(d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un Service Sales Engineer per la nostra Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, a Ginevra (Svizzera). Segnalando a Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager supporterai l'organizzazione Vendite e i clienti durante il processo di vendita nell'area assegnata. Sarete parte del Team Vendite che si concentra sul Servizio Trasformatore Trazione in Europa. In qualità di Service Sales Engineer è il vostro compito emozionante per facilitare la transizione della mobilità sostenibile da un portafoglio di prodotti ferroviari all'avanguardia e servizi ferroviari per le apparecchiature di rotolamento stock. In questo team, lavorerai con i colleghi internazionali che hanno molti anni di esperienza all'interno del business di servizio del trasformatore di trazione on-board per le apparecchiature di rolling stock. Con sede a Ginevra, il ruolo si assumerà la responsabilità per i clienti ferroviari in Europa (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing). Se sei un ingegnere altamente qualificato e motivato che cerca di unirsi a un team dinamico, ti invitiamo a applicare. Sostenere il team di vendita e i clienti in tutto il processo di vendita, sviluppando al tempo stesso nuovi e esistenti business aumentando la conoscenza interna ed esterna dei prodotti e del mercato Preparazione dell'offerta tecnica in conformità con il portafoglio unità e la necessità del cliente. Rivendicare gli aspetti tecnici e commerciali dell'offerta Partecipando alle discussioni sulla strategia di vendita, assegnando obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine e negoziando i vari budget di vendita del Gruppo di prodotti e piani di marketing Identificare le esigenze dei clienti e le offerte dei concorrenti attraverso l'analisi del mercato, assicurando un'efficace azione di marketing e comunicazione dimostra la proposizione di valore dei prodotti, sistemi, servizi e pacchetti La tua laurea di primo livello in ingegneria e più di 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite dirette e delle vendite La conoscenza del mercato delle ferrovie e dei clienti ferroviari (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing) è un vantaggio Fluente in francese e inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio Esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, gestione del conto e cross-selling attraverso sistemi, soluzioni, prodotti e categorie di servizi Comprensione di preparazione dell'offerta, negoziazione del contratto, gestione del rischio e termini commerciali e legali Viaggiare principalmente all'interno dell'Unione Europea se necessario. I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen Service Sales Engineer für unsere Traction Transformers Service Business Unit in Genf (Schweiz). Mit der Berichterstattung an den Traction Service Sales und Marketing Manager unterstützen Sie die Vertriebsorganisation und Kunden während des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses im zugewiesenen Bereich. Sie werden Teil des Vertriebsteams sein, das sich auf den Traction Transformer Service in Europa konzentriert. Als Service Sales Engineer ist es Ihre spannende Aufgabe, den nachhaltigen Mobilitätsübergang durch ein hochmodernes Schienenprodukt- und Schienenservice-Portfolio für Fahrzeuge zu erleichtern. In diesem Team arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Peers mit langjähriger Erfahrung im On-Board Traktionstransformator-Service-Geschäft für Fahrzeuge. Mit Sitz in Genf übernimmt die Rolle für die Bahnkunden in Europa (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasingunternehmen). Wenn Sie ein hochqualifizierter und motivierter Ingenieur sind, der sich einem dynamischen Team anschließen möchte, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams und der Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses ausüben, während Sie neue und bestehende Unternehmen entwickeln, indem Sie interne und externe Kenntnisse der Produkte und des Marktes erhöhen. Erklären Sie technische und kommerzielle Aspekte des Angebots Participating in Sales-Strategie-Diskussionen, Zuordnung von kurzfristigen und langfristigen Zielen und Verhandeln der verschiedenen Produktgruppen-Vertriebsbudgets und Marketing-Pläne Identifikation der Kundenbedürfnisse und Konkurrenten Angebote durch Marktanalyse, Sicherstellung effizienter Marketing-Aktionen und Kommunikation zeigen die Wertvorstellung der Produkte, Systeme, Dienstleistungen und Pakete Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften und mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Direktverkaufs- und Vertriebsmanagement Kenntnisse von Schienenfahrzeugen und Schienenkunden (OEM Zughersteller, Schienenbetreiber, Leasingunternehmen) ist ein Vorteil Fluent in Französisch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen. Andere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Kontomanagement und Cross-Selling über Systeme, Lösungen, Produkte und Dienstleistungskategorien Verstehen von Angebotsvorbereitung, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement und kommerzielle und rechtliche Bedingungen Reisen vor allem innerhalb der Europäischen Union bei Bedarf. Häufige Interaktion mit Schienenkunden und HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team werden erwartet Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und professionelle Leistung zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Service Sales Engineer pour notre Unité Service Transformateurs de Traction, à Genève (Suisse). Relevant du Service de Traction Sales and Marketing Manager, vous accompagnerez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente dans la zone affectée. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe des ventes qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. En tant que Service Sales Engineer, il s'agit de votre tâche passionnante de faciliter la transition vers une mobilité durable grâce à un portefeuille de produits ferroviaires de pointe et de services ferroviaires pour le matériel roulant. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes un ingénieur hautement qualifié et motivé cherchant à rejoindre une équipe dynamique, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente, tout en développant des activités nouvelles et existantes en augmentant les connaissances internes et externes des produits et du marché. Clarifier les aspects techniques et commerciaux de l'offre Participer aux discussions sur la stratégie de vente, assigner des objectifs à court et à long terme et négocier les divers budgets de vente et plans de marketing du Groupe de produits Identifier les besoins des clients et les offres des concurrents par l'analyse du marché, assurer des actions de marketing et des communications efficaces démontrer la proposition de valeur des produits, des systèmes, des services et des forfaits Soutenir la région Organisme de vente/clients pour déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées et les plus rentables sur le plan technique et fournir un soutien technique, des présentations de produits et une formation liée au produit\/solution\/service. Votre formation Baccalauréat en ingénierie et plus de 2 ans d'expérience en vente directe et gestion des ventes Connaissance du marché du matériel roulant ferroviaire et des clients du rail (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location) est un avantage Fluent en français et en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé. D'autres langues sont un avantage Expérience dans le développement des entreprises, la gestion des comptes et la vente croisée entre les systèmes, les solutions, les produits et les catégories de services Compréhension de la préparation des offres, de la négociation des contrats, de la gestion des risques et des termes commerciaux et juridiques Voyageant principalement au sein de l'Union européenne si nécessaire. Une interaction fréquente avec les clients ferroviaires et HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team sont attendues Plus sur nous Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  As a Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist part of the local HSE team, you will play a key role in participating to HSE development, with main focus on Environmental topic, but granting a good support on Health & Safety activities.  Key tasks on the Environmental side will be related to safeguarding our site's environmental integrity and driving our sustainability ambitions forward. In this role, you will ensure full compliance with all relevant environmental laws, regulations, and permits, while fostering strong relationships with community stakeholders and environmental authorities. You will develop, implement, and maintain robust environmental policies and procedures that promote accountability across the organization. By conducting environmental risk assessments, delivering training on sustainability practices, and leading initiatives that improve resource efficiency, you will directly contribute to reducing the factory's environmental footprint and supporting long-term operational excellence.  On the H&S part, you'll be required to support main Health and Safety development activities organized by the HSE Manager, delivering results according to Management expectations.  Please submit your application in English.   How you'll make an impact  Ensure regulatory compliance with Swiss environmental law and related frameworks (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), including permit management and coordination with cantonal authorities (BAFU)  Lead environmental impact assessments for new production lines, plant changes, and modifications, ensuring alignment with internal environmental policies  Manage waste and disposals, including segregation, traceability, registers, supplier audits, and all special waste streams, while supporting wastereduction and VVEA improvement initiatives  Oversee chemical compliance, including ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, Manage and maintain Safety SDS requirements, and notifications of new substances  Support safe handling and storage of dangerous goods (DG) by coordinating with relevant departments and ensuring ongoing compliance  Plan and conduct environmental audits and inspections, identifying improvement areas and ensuring timely corrective actions, also providing environmental compliance support and training to Engineering, Maintenance, and overall Business Unit, including REACH\/RoHS documentation and sustainability-related data needs  On the Health and Safety part, you're required to support HSE manager in H&S-related topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation.  Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders.  Your background  Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental regulations and compliance obligations   Solid understanding of best practices in emissions, waste, water, chemicals, and sustainability   Strong analytical skills, including environmental data processing and use of relevant software tools   Basic knowledge of H&S principles and concepts   Excellent command of Office 365 applications   Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess environmental risks and develop effective mitigation strategies   Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with diverse internal and external stakeholders   Fluent in Italian and English  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Come Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist parte del team HSE locale, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella partecipazione allo sviluppo HSE, con l'obiettivo principale sul tema ambientale, ma garantendo un buon supporto alle attività di salute e sicurezza. I compiti chiave sul lato ambientale saranno legati alla salvaguardia dell'integrità ambientale del nostro sito e alla promozione delle nostre ambizioni di sostenibilità. In questo ruolo, si assicurerà il pieno rispetto di tutte le pertinenti leggi ambientali, regolamenti e permessi, mentre promuovendo forti relazioni con le parti interessate della comunità e le autorità ambientali. Si svilupperà, implementerà e manterrà robuste politiche e procedure ambientali che promuovono la responsabilità in tutta l'organizzazione. Condurre valutazioni dei rischi ambientali, fornire formazione sulle pratiche di sostenibilità e le principali iniziative che migliorano l'efficienza delle risorse, contribuirà direttamente a ridurre l'impronta ambientale della fabbrica e sostenere l'eccellenza operativa a lungo termine. Nella parte H&S, sarai tenuto a sostenere le principali attività di sviluppo della salute e della sicurezza organizzate dal HSE Manager, offrendo risultati secondo le aspettative della Direzione. Invia la tua richiesta in inglese. Assicurare il rispetto delle normative in materia ambientale e dei relativi quadri (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), comprese le norme relative alla gestione dei permessi e al coordinamento con le autorità cantonali (BAFU) Nella parte Salute e Sicurezza, sei tenuto a sostenere HSE manager in temi legati alla H&S che gestiscono attività di produzione e attrezzature con i più elevati standard di sicurezza, sia sul piano pratico che sulla preparazione della documentazione. Sostenere le attività di reportistica HSE richieste dagli stakeholder interni governativi o Hitachi Energy. Il vostro background Min. 3 anni di esperienza in ruoli ambientali all'interno del settore industriale e una forte conoscenza delle normative ambientali e degli obblighi di conformità Solida comprensione delle migliori pratiche in termini di emissioni, rifiuti, acqua, prodotti chimici e sostenibilità Forte competenze analitiche, tra cui il trattamento dei dati ambientali e l'utilizzo di strumenti software rilevanti Conoscenza di base dei principi e concetti H&S Ottimo comando di Office 365 applicazioni Forte capacità di problem solving con la capacità di valutare i rischi ambientali e sviluppare strategie di mitigazione efficaci.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Als spezialisierter Teil des lokalen HSE-Teams von Factory Environmental and Employe Health & Safety werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Teilnahme an der HSE-Entwicklung spielen, mit Schwerpunkt auf Umweltthemen, aber eine gute Unterstützung für Gesundheit und Sicherheit. Die wichtigsten Aufgaben auf der Umweltseite werden sich auf die Sicherung der Umweltintegrität unserer Website und die Durchsetzung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsziele beziehen. In dieser Rolle sorgen Sie für die volle Einhaltung aller einschlägigen Umweltgesetze, -vorschriften und -genehmigungen und fördern gleichzeitig starke Beziehungen zu Interessenvertretern und Umweltbehörden der Gemeinschaft. Sie entwickeln, implementieren und pflegen robuste Umweltpolitiken und -verfahren, die die Rechenschaftspflicht im gesamten Unternehmen fördern. Durch Umweltrisikobewertungen, Schulungen zu Nachhaltigkeitspraktiken und führende Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Ressourceneffizienz werden Sie direkt dazu beitragen, den ökologischen Fußabdruck der Fabrik zu reduzieren und langfristige betriebliche Exzellenz zu unterstützen. Zum H&S-Teil werden Sie verpflichtet, die wichtigsten Aktivitäten der Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsentwicklung, die vom HSE-Manager organisiert werden, zu unterstützen und die Ergebnisse nach den Erwartungen der Managements zu liefern. Bitte geben Sie Ihre Bewerbung in Englisch ein. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Einhaltung des schweizerischen Umweltrechts und der damit verbundenen Rahmenbedingungen (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO) gewährleisten, einschließlich Genehmigungsmanagement und Koordinierung mit Kantonalbehörden (RoFU) Führen Sie Umweltverträglichkeitsprüfungen für neue Produktionslinien, Anlagenänderungen und Änderungen, Im Bereich Gesundheit und Sicherheit sind Sie verpflichtet, HSE-Manager in H&S-bezogenen Themen zu unterstützen, die Produktionsaktivitäten und Ausrüstungen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards verwalten, sowohl im praktischen als auch in der Dokumentationsvorbereitung. Unterstützung von HSE-Reporting-Aktivitäten, die von staatlichen oder Hitachi Energy internen Akteuren benötigt werden. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de l'environnement et de la sécurité des employés faisant partie de l'équipe locale de SSE, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la participation au développement de SSE, en mettant l'accent sur le thème environnemental, mais en accordant un bon soutien aux activités de SSE. Les principales tâches du côté environnemental seront liées à la protection de l'intégrité environnementale de notre site et à la promotion de nos ambitions en matière de durabilité. Dans ce rôle, vous assurerez le plein respect de toutes les lois, règlements et permis environnementaux pertinents, tout en favorisant des relations solides avec les intervenants communautaires et les autorités environnementales. Vous allez élaborer, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des politiques et des procédures environnementales solides qui favorisent la reddition de comptes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. En procédant à des évaluations des risques environnementaux, en offrant une formation sur les pratiques de durabilité et en dirigeant des initiatives qui améliorent l'efficacité des ressources, vous contribuerez directement à réduire l'empreinte environnementale de l'usine et à soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle à long terme. En ce qui a trait à la santé et à la sécurité, vous devrez appuyer les principales activités de développement de la santé et de la sécurité organisées par le gestionnaire de l'ESH, en donnant des résultats en fonction des attentes de la direction. Veuillez soumettre votre candidature en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Assurer la conformité réglementaire avec le droit suisse de l'environnement et les cadres connexes (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), y compris la gestion des permis et la coordination avec les autorités cantonales (BAFU) Diriger les évaluations de l'impact environnemental pour les nouvelles lignes de production, les changements d'usine et les modifications, assurer l'alignement sur les politiques environnementales internes Gérer les déchets et les éliminations, y compris la ségrégation, la traçabilité, les registres, les audits des fournisseurs et tous les flux spéciaux de déchets, tout en appuyant les initiatives de réduction des déchets et d'amélioration de la VVEA Surveiller la conformité chimique, y compris ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, gérer et maintenir les exigences de la SDD en matière de sécurité, et les notifications de nouvelles substances Soutenir la manutention et l'entreposage sécuritaires des marchandises dangereuses (DG) en coordonnant avec les ministères concernés et en assurant la conformité continue Plan et des vérifications et inspections environnementales, en déterminant les domaines d'amélioration et en veillant à des mesures Pour ce qui est de la santé et de la sécurité, vous êtes tenu d'appuyer le gestionnaire de l'ESH dans la gestion des activités de production et de l'équipement ayant les normes de sécurité les plus élevées, tant sur le plan pratique que sur la préparation de la documentation. Appuyer les activités de rapport sur les ESE requises par les intervenants internes du gouvernement ou de Hitachi Energy. Vos antécédents 3 ans d'expérience dans les rôles environnementaux dans le secteur industriel et une solide connaissance de la réglementation et des obligations suisses en matière d'environnement Compréhension solide des meilleures pratiques en matière d'émissions, de déchets, d'eau, de produits chimiques et de durabilité Fortes compétences analytiques, y compris le traitement des données environnementales et l'utilisation d'outils logiciels pertinents Connaissance de base des principes et concepts de H & S Excellente maîtrise des applications Office 365 Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'évaluer les risques environnementaux et d'élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation efficaces Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite pour s'engager auprès de divers intervenants internes et externes Fluent en italien et en anglais Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

jobs.title: R&D Team Manager – Next Generation Grids Transformers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Hitachi Energy is seeking an experienced and motivated R&D Team Manager to lead our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva, Switzerland.   In this role, you will manage a team of 5+ engineers and drive the development of advanced and innovative technologies, including medium frequency transformers and power electronics enhanced transformers. You will combine people leadership with strong technical guidance and project ownership, contributing to the execution of R&D strategy in a global environment.  How you'll make an impact     Lead, develop, and motivate an international R&D team of 5+ engineers with know-how in medium frequency transformers, power converters and lab testing Provide technical leadership and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges  Contribute to R&D strategy and technology direction, including development of roadmaps for the New Generation Grids Transformers product line  Plan, drive, and deliver R&D projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and quality targets  Collaborate closely with global R&D teams, engineering functions, and external partners  Manage project resources and budgets to maximize impact and operational efficiency Site R&D laboratory and infrastructure responsibility, including driving expansion plans  Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to improve performance  Your background    Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field  Several years of industrial experience in product development, or technology management  Strong technical background in transformers and power converters  Proven experience in project management within R&D or product development  Experience in leading technical teams (line or project leadership) and working in international and cross-functional environments  Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) as well as stakeholder engagement capabilities  More about us You will join a collaborative and international R&D environment at the forefront of next-generation grid technologies. Working in Geneva, you will contribute to innovative transformer solutions that support the energy transition and the development of more flexible and sustainable power systems. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptionByLocale.it: L'occasione Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Team Manager R&D esperto e motivato per guidare il nostro team di Next Generation Grids Transformers a Ginevra, in Svizzera. In questo ruolo, gestirai un team di 5+ ingegneri e guiderai lo sviluppo di tecnologie avanzate e innovative, tra cui trasformatori di media frequenza e trasformatori potenziati di potenza elettronica. Combinate la leadership delle persone con una forte guida tecnica e la proprietà del progetto, contribuendo all'esecuzione della strategia R&D in un ambiente globale. Come farete un impatto, sviluppare e motivare un team internazionale di R&D di 5+ ingegneri con know-how in trasformatori di media frequenza, convertitori di potenza e test di laboratorio Fornire la leadership tecnica e supportare il team nella risoluzione di complesse sfide ingegneristiche Contribuire a R&D strategia e direzione della tecnologia, tra cui lo sviluppo di roadmap per la nuova generazione Grids Transformers linea di prodotti Piano, guidare e fornire progetti R&D a stretto contatto con la qualità Lavorando a Ginevra, contribuirai a soluzioni innovative per trasformatori che supportano la transizione energetica e lo sviluppo di sistemi di potenza più flessibili e sostenibili. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere
