descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Hitachi Energy sucht einen erfahrenen und motivierten R&D Team Manager, um unser Team von Next Generation Grids Transformers in Genf, Schweiz, zu leiten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie ein Team von 5+ Ingenieuren verwalten und die Entwicklung fortschrittlicher und innovativer Technologien, einschließlich mittlerer Frequenztransformatoren und Leistungselektronik verbessert Transformatoren. Sie kombinieren die Führung der Menschen mit einer starken technischen Anleitung und Projektbesitz und tragen zur Umsetzung der FuE-Strategie in einem globalen Umfeld bei. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf das internationale R&D-Team von 5+ Ingenieuren mit Know-how in mittleren Frequenzumformern, Stromumformern und Labortests ausüben, technische Führung und Unterstützung des Teams bei der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen In Genf werden Sie zu innovativen Transformatorlösungen beitragen, die den Energieübergang und die Entwicklung flexiblerer und nachhaltigerer Stromsysteme unterstützen. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un gestionnaire d'équipe de R & D expérimenté et motivé pour diriger notre équipe de transformation de réseaux de nouvelle génération à Genève, en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez une équipe de plus de 5 ingénieurs et piloterez le développement de technologies avancées et innovantes, y compris des transformateurs à moyenne fréquence et des transformateurs à puissance électronique améliorée. Vous combinerez le leadership des gens avec une solide orientation technique et l'appropriation de projets, contribuant à l'exécution de la stratégie de R-D dans un environnement mondial. Comment vous ferez un impact Diriger, développer et motiver une équipe internationale d'ingénieurs de R-D de plus de 5 ans ayant un savoir-faire dans les transformateurs à moyenne fréquence, les convertisseurs de puissance et les essais en laboratoire Fournir un leadership technique et aider l'équipe à résoudre des défis complexes en matière d'ingénierie Contribuer à la stratégie de R-D et à l'orientation technologique, y compris à l'élaboration de feuilles de route pour la gamme de produits des transformateurs de nouvelle génération Planifier, piloter et exécuter des projets de R-D, assurer l'alignement avec la portée, les délais et les objectifs de qualité Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes mondiales de R-D, les fonctions d'ingénierie et les partenaires externes Gérer les ressources et les budgets des projets pour maximiser l'impact et l'efficacité opérationnelle Laboratoire de R-D et les responsabilités en matière d'infrastructure, y compris les plans d'expansion Présenter et mettre en oeuvre de nouveaux outils, technologies et processus pour améliorer le rendement Vos antécédents Maîtrise ou doctorat en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe Plusieurs années d'expérience industrielle dans le développement de produits ou la gestion de technologies Forte expérience technique dans les transformateurs et les convertisseurs d'énergie Expérience de En travaillant à Genève, vous contribuerez à des solutions innovantes de transformateurs qui soutiennent la transition énergétique et le développement de systèmes électriques plus flexibles et durables. Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir

jobs.title: Internship in Computational Chemistry 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months.    How you'll make an impact  Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization  Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages  Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team    Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods  Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage  Fluency in written and spoken English  Team player and well organized  Creative and able to work autonomously  Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus  More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it: Attraverso la posizione forma attivamente il futuro – dove la sicurezza e l'innovazione si incontrano. Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista ambientale dedicato e specializzato o di uno specialista ambientale dedicato ed esperto che rafforza ulteriormente il nostro impegno in un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. In questa funzione centrale, sei responsabile di iniziative per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, garantire il rispetto delle normative pertinenti e promuovere una sicurezza proattiva e la cultura ambientale in tutta l'azienda. Ciò consente di garantire il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza nonché delle linee guida interne Condurre i rischi, i rischi e le analisi ambientali, comprese le misure derivanti Piani e l'esecuzione di audit interni, approcci e controlli ambientali Ispezione di incidenti e eventi e lo sviluppo di misure di prevenzione Lavorare con la sostenibilità e progetti ambientali e promuovere la cultura ambientale Questo ti permette di sviluppare continuamente il tuo lavoro con scienze ambientali, tecnologia ambientale, sicurezza del lavoro o simili scienze tecniche/nature (FH\/University) esperienza lavorativa pluriennale in HSE o settori ambientali, idealmente nell'industria, nella produzione o nelle organizzazioni tecniche.
descriptionByLocale.en: Through the position shapes actively the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a dedicated and specialist environmental specialist or a dedicated and expertly-competent environmental specialist that further strengthens our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central function, you are responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture throughout the company. This allows you to ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations as well as internal guidelines Conducting risk, hazard and environmental analyses including deriving measures Plans and performing internal audits, approaches and environmental controls Inspecting accidents and events and developing prevention measures Working with sustainability and environmental projects and promoting environmental culture This allows you to continuously develop your work with environmental sciences, environmental technology, work safety or comparable technical/nature sciences (FH\/University) multiannual work experience in HSE or environmental fields, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Grâce à cette position, l'avenir se dessine activement – où la sécurité et l'innovation se rencontrent. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste de l'environnement ou d'un spécialiste de l'environnement spécialisé et expert qui renforce notre engagement envers un environnement de travail sûr, sain et durable. Dans cette fonction centrale, vous êtes responsable des initiatives visant à protéger nos employés, à assurer le respect des règlements pertinents et à promouvoir une culture proactive en matière de sécurité et d'environnement dans toute l'entreprise. Cela vous permet d'assurer le respect des règlements sur l'environnement et la sécurité ainsi que des lignes directrices internes Effectuer des analyses des risques, des risques et de l'environnement, y compris l'élaboration de mesures Planifier et effectuer des audits internes, des approches et des contrôles environnementaux Inspection des accidents et des événements et élaboration de mesures de prévention Travailler avec des projets de durabilité et d'environnement et promouvoir la culture environnementale Cela vous permet de développer continuellement votre travail avec les sciences de l'environnement, les technologies environnementales, la sécurité du travail ou des sciences techniques/natures comparables (FH\/Université) expérience de travail pluriannuelle dans les domaines de la SSE ou de l'environnement, idéalement dans l'industrie, la production ou les organisations techniques.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

L'opportunità In questo ruolo, sarai un esperto di materia riconosciuta nella sicurezza, fornendo un supporto funzionale competente in un paese o in un cluster di paesi. Sarete responsabili per la ricerca, l'analisi e l'interpretazione di minacce di sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero influenzare dipendenti, beni o operazioni. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'attuazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Segnalando al Capo della Sicurezza Regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, professionisti di livello inferiore, e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di sicurezza esperti. Come farai ad avere un impatto
- Analizzare le minacce di sicurezza nazionali e internazionali emergenti e fornire valutazioni tempestive e consiglieri.
- Fornire un supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza regionali e i KPI.
- Assicurare la conformità attraverso audit, controlli e monitoraggio della legislazione in evoluzione della sicurezza.
- Fornire consigli di gestione dei rischi di sicurezza esperti per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave.

The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. - Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives.
- Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance.
- Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting.
- Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background

- Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization.

- Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively.

- Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination.

descriptionByLocale.it: In Hitachi, stiamo plasmando il futuro con precisione, innovazione e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Industrial Engineering team, where team members work within two clearly differentiated focus areas: production development and industrial engineering. Each role has a defined main focus in one of these domains, while both profiles collaborate closely within the same team and contribute to shared production goals. Depending on your background, you will take ownership of one focus area while staying connected to the broader engineering activities. You will work hands‑on with production, engineering, and suppliers in a highly collaborative environment. This setup allows you to deepen your expertise while understanding adjacent processes. You will grow through real shopfloor impact, responsibility, and cross‑functional collaboration. jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

jobs.title: Project Manager GIS High Voltage 80 - 100%
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you driven to create global impact through the leadership of complex, high-value projects? Do you combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities? Within Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Product Group, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our global Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) business, based in Zürich-Oerlikon, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of strategically important projects in a global, matrix organization. You will lead cross-functional teams across regions, act as a key interface to international customers, and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of complex, international projects from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to global customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and factory acceptance tests Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (7+ years) managing complex projects in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives and internal leadership Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Au sein du groupe de produits haute tension d'Hitachi Energy, nous façonnons l'avenir de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. Dans notre entreprise mondiale de Switchgear Isolated Gas (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, nous proposons des solutions avancées avec les plus hautes normes de fiabilité et d'innovation. Nous cherchons un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté pour prendre en charge des projets stratégiques importants dans une organisation mondiale et matricielle. jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for an Application Compliance Project Manager to support the definition, coordination, and execution of our global application compliance roadmap. In this role, you will work closely with the Head of Global IT Compliance and act as a key interface between Business Solution Teams, Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow, and delivery teams. If you enjoy enabling teams, coordinating cross‑functional activities, and contributing to a consistent governance approach across the organization, this opportunity is for you. How you'll make an impact Support the definition and maintenance of the global application compliance roadmap Translate compliance strategy and policy into an actionable delivery plan Coordinate and guide application compliance activities across teams Serve as the primary interface between Business Solution Teams and core IT Drive consistent adoption of Application Lifecylce Management (ALM), Application Onboarding SOP and other compliance relevant instructions Coordinate delivery efforts with Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow, and other teams Track progress, milestones, and cross‑team dependencies Identify risks or misalignments and escalate when needed Your background Strong ITIL background with demonstrated expertise in application management processes and their compliance, risk, and control implications, including experience in IT\/application compliance, assurance, or audit Proven experience in Global IT Governance, enterprise risk management (IRM), and executing cross‑functional roadmaps across multiple stakeholders Solid understanding of ServiceNow workflows and their use within governance, risk, and compliance processes Excellent project, stakeholder, and committee coordination skills, with the ability to organize, drive alignment, and deliver outcomes More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring together curious, collaborative people committed to continuous learning and positive impact. Diversity, inclusion, and teamwork are at the core of how we operate. With our innovative technologies and global reach, we support customers and partners in accelerating the energy transition and shaping a more sustainable world.

jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Descrizione
L'Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy come professionista HSE e gioca un ruolo chiave nella guida di una forte salute, sicurezza e cultura ambientale nelle nostre operazioni di fabbrica a Zurigo. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i team di leadership e interfunzionali per garantire la conformità, minimizzare i rischi e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni HSE, supportando operazioni sostenibili e sicure.

Come si fa un impatto
- Assicurare il rispetto delle normative HSE, delle politiche interne e degli standard Hitachi Energy in tutta la fabbrica
- Condurre valutazioni dei rischi, audit e ispezioni per identificare i rischi e definire azioni di mitigazione
- Guidare le indagini sugli incidenti e attuare misure correttive e preventive efficaci
- Monitorare i KPI HSE, preparare i report e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati
- Offrire e coordinare sessioni di formazione HSE, promuovendo la consapevolezza e le migliori pratiche
- Sostenere gli audit interni, esterni e di certificazione, assicurando tempestive azioni di follow-up
- Collaborare con team interfunzionali e stakeholder esterni per integrare HSE nelle operazioni quotidiane
- Guidare iniziative HSE e programmi di miglioramento ambientale (ad esempio rifiuti, acqua, energia)

Il tuo sfondo
- Minimo 5 anni di esperienza HSE in un ambiente industriale o energetico
- Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze Ambientali, Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro, o campo simile
- Professionista certificato HSE secondo la legislazione svizzera (obbligatorio)
- Forte conoscenza degli standard ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 e HSE
- Esperienza comprovata nella valutazione dei rischi, nell'analisi degli incidenti e nel reporting delle prestazioni
- Forte capacità di comunicazione e formazione con la capacità di influenzare i comportamenti
- mentalità analitica, proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con uno stile di lavoro collaborativo
- Fluente in tedesco e inglese; ulteriore competenza in ergonomia o materiali pericolosi è un plus

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
- Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

## Descrizione
The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations.

How You'll Make an Impact
- Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory
- Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions
- Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures
- Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making
- Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices
- Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations
- Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy)

Your Background
- Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment
- Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field
- Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory)
- Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations
- Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting
- Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors
- Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style
- Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus

More about us
- Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Befristet: Automatiker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitern bietet Hitachi Energy eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios. Darunter; Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Turn-Off-Thyristoren (GTOs), Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBTs) und MOSFETs -, die in Industrie, Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbaren Energien für ihre hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit geschätzt werden. Für unser Team suchen wir befristet eine\/n Automatiker\/in, der\/die beim Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme unserer Leistungshalbleiter-Testsysteme mitwirkt. Das kannst du bewirken Aufbau von Leistungshalbleiter-Testsystemen inklusive Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik Durchführung von Anpassungsarbeiten an fehlerhaften Konstruktionen, Fertigungsteilen oder Schemen Kontrolle aller mechanischen, pneumatischen, elektrischen, programmierten und hydraulischen Funktionen Durchführung von Erdungsmessungen (Überprüfung der Durchgängigkeit des Schutzleitersystems nach EN 60204-1 18b) Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Isolationskoordinationsprotokollen Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme und Isolationskoordination von Testsystemen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Systemen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Automatiker\/in EFZ (evtl. mit höherer Fachschule), idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung in der Montage Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Fundiertes Know-how in der mechanischen Bearbeitung von Materialien (Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren, Sägen etc.) Vertrautheit mit Leistungshalbleitern, Messtechnik sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Normen Sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Befristete Position in einem international führenden Hightech-Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle 
• Aufgaben im Bereich Leistungshalbleiter Offene Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Sozialleistungen und moderne Arbeitsmittel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come leader globale nei semiconduttori di potenza, Hitachi Energy offre uno dei più diversi portfolio di prodotti. Tra questi: Tiristori, diodi, tiristori di gate-turn-off (GTO), tiristori integrati a cancello commutato (IGCT), transistor bipolari a cancello isolato (IGBT) e MOSFET, che sono stimati nell'industria, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia, mobilità e energie rinnovabili per la loro alta qualità e affidabilità. Per il nostro team stiamo cercando un 'automatico' che aiuta a costruire e commissionare i nostri sistemi di prova semiconduttore di potenza. Questo consente di costruire sistemi di prova a semiconduttore di potenza tra cui meccanica, elettrica, pneumatica e idraulica per eseguire lavori di adattamento su costruzioni difettose, parti o schemi di produzione per controllare tutte le funzioni meccaniche, pneumatiche, elettriche, programmate e idrauliche per eseguire misurazioni di messa a terra (controllare la continuità del sistema di scale di protezione secondo EN 60204-1 18b) Questo ti porta con una formazione completa come tecnico automatico (forse con una scuola tecnica superiore), idealmente con esperienza professionale nell'esperienza di assemblaggio nella gestione dei progetti Il know-how finanziato nella lavorazione meccanica dei materiali (torno, fresatura, perforazione, segatura, ecc.) Confidenza con semiconduttori di potenza, tecnologia di misura e linee guida e standard rilevanti Gestione sicura con Office 365 Molto buono tedesco e buona conoscenza inglese in parola e scrittura Più su di noi Posizione limitata in una società high-tech leader a livello internazionale Varied e responsabile
• Compiti nel settore dei semiconduttori di potenza Aprire la cultura aziendale con brevi percorsi decisionali Vantaggi sociali attraenti e risorse di lavoro moderne
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a global leader in power semiconductors, Hitachi Energy offers one of the most diverse product portfolios. Among them: Thyristors, diodes, gate-turn-off thyristors (GTOs), integrated gate-commutated thyristors (IGCTs), insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs) and MOSFETs, which are estimated in industry, energy transmission and distribution, mobility and renewable energies for their high quality and reliability. For our team we are looking for a 'automatic' that helps to build and commission our power semiconductor test systems. This allows you to build power semiconductor test systems including mechanics, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulics to perform adaptation work on faulty constructions, manufacturing parts or schemes to control all mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, programmed and hydraulic functions to perform grounding measurements (checking the continuity of the protective ladder system according to EN 60204-1 18b) This brings you with completed training as an automatic technician (possibly with a higher technical school), ideally with professional experience in assembly experience in project management Funded know-how in mechanical processing of materials (turning, milling, drilling, sawing, etc.) Confidence with power semiconductors, measurement technology as well as relevant guidelines and standards Safe handling with Office 365 Very good German and good English knowledge in word and writing More about us Limited position in an internationally leading high-tech company Varied and responsible
• Tasks in the field of power semiconductors Open corporate culture with short decision paths Attractive social benefits and modern work resources

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que leader mondial des semi-conducteurs électriques, Hitachi Energy offre l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés. Parmi eux: Thyristors, diodes, thyristors à orifices de sortie (GTO), thyristors intégrés à orifices de sortie (IGCT), transistors bipolaires à orifices isolés (IGBT) et MOSFETs, estimés dans l'industrie, transmission et distribution d'énergie, mobilité et énergies renouvelables pour leur haute qualité et fiabilité. Cela vous permet de construire des systèmes d'essai de semi-conducteurs électriques, électriques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques pour effectuer des travaux d'adaptation sur des constructions défectueuses, des pièces de fabrication ou des schémas pour contrôler toutes les fonctions mécaniques, pneumatiques, électriques, programmées et hydrauliques pour effectuer des mesures de mise à la terre (contrôle de la continuité du système d'échelle de protection selon EN 60204-1 18b) Cela vous apporte avec une formation complète en tant que technicien automatique (éventuellement avec une école technique supérieure), idéalement avec une expérience professionnelle dans l'assemblage d'expérience en gestion de projet Savoir-faire financé dans le traitement mécanique des matériaux (tournage, fraisage, forage, sciage, etc.) Confiance avec les semi-conducteurs électriques, la technologie de mesure ainsi que les lignes directrices et normes pertinentes Gestion sûre avec Office 365 Très bon allemand et bonne connaissance de l'anglais dans la parole et l'écriture Plus sur nous Position limitée dans une société de haute technologie de leader international Varié et responsable

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer or Technician - Diffusion/Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sei appassionato di guidare l'innovazione e garantire il massimo uptime di strumenti di produzione semiconduttore? descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione
L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale vi aspetta. Si può aspettare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere in esso. Senior così come le applicazioni junior sono benvenuti!

Mansioni
- Gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV - 550KV.
- Responsabile per la riuscita dell'esecuzione dell'installazione/manutenzione/riparazioni in loco in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e nel rispetto dei requisiti legali locali.
- Responsabile per la qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo della qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale.
- Condurre la formazione del prodotto in loco sul prodotto e durante l'installazione (opzionale).
- Coordinamento del lavoro locale.
- Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto.
- Contribuire attivamente ai miglioramenti del processo e adottare proattivamente misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco.

Requisiti
- Apprendistato completo nella costruzione di metalli, nell'industria elettrica o automobilistica, o simili
- La conoscenza di base in ingegneria elettrica è un must desiderabile, ulteriore formazione in ingegneria elettrica è un vantaggio
- L'esperienza lavorativa nel montaggio e messa in servizio è un vantaggio
- Buone competenze in tedesco e inglese, almeno B2
- Volontà per incarichi nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con un tempo di viaggio fino al 90%
- Giocatore di squadra flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo
- Flair per soluzioni pragmatiche e non convenzionali con elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza

Cosa?
- Attività emozionanti e varie con grande libertà creativa
- Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo interessanti
- Attività/progetti interessanti e molto varie, inclusi incarichi off-shore

- Un pacchetto di benefici interessanti che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, nonché una voce nella scelta di alloggio
descriptionByLocale.en:

The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. - Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time
- Flexible, resilient and communicative team player
- Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards

- Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom
- Attractive training and development opportunities
- Interesting and very varied activities/projects, including off-shore assignments
- Well-established and dynamic team
- Open corporate culture
- An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

jobs.title: Internship Production Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic. 
• Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Nel nostro impianto BiMOS Backend di Lenzburg, Svizzera e Power Semiconductor di Praga, Repubblica Ceca, produciamo semiconduttori di potenza efficienti e di alta qualità per l'uso in unità di controllo motore, applicazioni di trazione, applicazioni industriali e sistemi di inverter. In questo modo, forniamo un contributo decisivo per rendere più efficiente l'industria, i trasporti pubblici e privati, mentre la nostra tecnologia consente anche la produzione e il trasporto di energia rinnovabile dal sito produttivo al consumatore. Un nuovo impianto di produzione è stato istituito a Praga per uno dei nostri prodotti originali per il produttore di apparecchiature (OEM). Questa mossa è motivata da considerazioni di capacità e continuità aziendale. Come parte del vostro stage in sviluppo di produzione, vi aiuterà con il trasferimento di capacità produttive da Lenzburg a Praga. Si gioca un ruolo vitale nel facilitare l'introduzione e la rampa di prodotti semiconduttori di energia Hitachi nel nostro secondo sito di produzione a Praga \ / Repubblica Ceca.
• Le vostre responsabilità si concentrano su garantire l'eccellenza operativa, l'integrità del processo e il trasferimento effettivo della conoscenza in luoghi. Sostenere l'implementazione e la qualificazione di nuovi strumenti di produzione, assicurando loro di soddisfare gli standard di prestazioni e affidabilità Assistendo all'integrazione delle attrezzature, nonché alla raccolta e all'analisi dei dati di produzione e di processo Istituzione di procedure di controllo della qualità e dei corrispondenti loop di controllo per mantenere la coerenza e la conformità del prodotto Organizzare e sostenere la formazione di nuovi personale di produzione, garantendo un trasferimento di conoscenza efficace dal sito di Lenzburg alla nuova fabbrica Il tuo background Ingegneria di studio, fisica, chimica, tecnologia di produzione o discipline correlate; tenere un diploma di laurea è preferito. L'assegnazione può essere parte della tesi di un maestro Mostra un vero interesse per la produzione di semiconduttori, tra cui aree come processi innovativi, logistica e governance Mostra competenze di comunicazione efficaci per la collaborazione con diversi stakeholder e team interfunzionali, nonché un interesse per la collaborazione internazionale e la condivisione delle conoscenze Mostra attenzione ai dettagli nella documentazione e nella configurazione dei processi, insieme alle capacità organizzative per sostenere la formazione, la pianificazione e il trasferimento di conoscenze Adapt facilmente per cambiare ambienti, abbracciare nuovi strumenti, e impegnarsi a un compito operativo di sei mesi in Svizzera a nove Mastering of German è un vantaggio Più su di noi Questo tirocinio fornisce esperienza pratica con i processi produttivi e l'eccellenza operativa in un ambiente semiconduttore di potenza leader. Offre la possibilità di sviluppare competenze tecniche e organizzative, supportando una grande espansione industriale in tutta la Svizzera e nella Repubblica Ceca. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.

Die Gelegenheit In unserem BiMOS Backend Werk in Lenzburg, der Schweiz und der Power Semiconductor Fabrik in Prag, Tschechien, fertigen wir effiziente, hochwertige Leistungshalbleiter für den Einsatz in Motorsteuergeräten, Traktionsanwendungen, Industrieanwendungen und Wechselrichtersystemen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Implementierung und Qualifizierung von neuen Produktionswerkzeugen ausüben, die Leistungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsstandards erfüllen. Begleitend zur Geräteintegration sowie zur Erfassung und Analyse von Produktions- und Prozessdaten Prozessqualitätskontrollverfahren und entsprechende Regelkreise zur Aufrechterhaltung der Produktkonsistenz und Compliance Organisation und Unterstützung der Ausbildung von neuen Produktionspersonal, um einen effektiven Wissenstransfer vom Standort Lenzburg zur neuen Fabrik zu gewährleisten. Ihr Hintergrund Studieningenieurwesen, Physik, Chemie, Produktionstechnik oder verwandten Disziplinen; ein Bachelor-Abschluss ist bevorzugt. Vous jouez un rôle essentiel pour faciliter l'introduction et la montée en puissance des produits Hitachi Energy Semiconductors sur notre deuxième site de fabrication à Prague \/ République tchèque.

jobs.title: R&D Power Semiconductor Chip Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'opportunità Nei nostri gruppi di chip semiconduttori R&D BiMOS di Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, stiamo sviluppando dispositivi semiconduttori di potenza avanzati attraverso più classi di tensione. I nostri prodotti di alta qualità sono fabbricati in siti di produzione interni ed esterni e consegnati ai clienti in tutto il mondo attraverso una vasta gamma di applicazioni, tra cui l'energia industriale, rinnovabile, trazione ed e-mobility. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un motivato R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist per contribuire allo sviluppo di tecnologie semiconduttori di potenza di nuova generazione. In questo ruolo, ci si concentrerà su dispositivi basati sul silicio (con una forte esposizione ai diodi di potenza) mentre si espande verso concetti di dispositivi più ampi come IGBTs e MOSFETs. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati con una solida base tecnica in fisica e simulazione dei dispositivi semiconduttori, che sono desiderosi di sviluppare ulteriormente le loro competenze in un ambiente R&D collaborativo e high-tech. Unisci un forte background tecnico nella fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori con esperienza pratica nella simulazione e nello sviluppo tecnologico? Siete motivati a prendere la proprietà dei compiti di sviluppo durante l'apprendimento continuo e la crescita? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione. Mansioni - Contribuire allo sviluppo di chip semiconduttore di potenza di nuova generazione, con una forte attenzione ai diodi di potenza in silicio e alle relative tecnologie di dispositivo - Supporta il ciclo di sviluppo della tecnologia end-to-end e del prodotto, dal concetto e dalla simulazione fino alla valutazione di validazione e affidabilità - Applicare e sviluppare ulteriormente i modelli di simulazione TCAD per comprendere il comportamento del dispositivo e ottimizzare le prestazioni, la resa e i costi - Collaborare a stretto contatto con ingegneri di processo, team di caratterizzazione e affidabilità, garantendo l'allineamento tra design e manifatabilità - Prendere la proprietà di singoli pacchetti di lavoro o sottoprogetti, contribuendo a obiettivi e tempi di progetto complessi - Miglioramento continuo attraverso l'analisi, la modellazione e l'ottimizzazione dei dati - Contribuire attivamente alla condivisione della conoscenza all'interno del team e costruire una forte comprensione a livello di sistemi di dispositivi e processi semiconduttori

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione The opportunity In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. ## Mansioni - Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies - Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment - Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost - Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability - Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines - Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches - Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes ##
• Requisiti - Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics - Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes - Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes - Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams - Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus - Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage - Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment - Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills ## Contatto

Unsere hochwertigen Produkte werden an internen und externen Produktionsstandorten hergestellt und an Kunden weltweit über eine breite Palette von Anwendungen geliefert, darunter industrielle, erneuerbare Energien, Traktion und E-Mobilität. Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Gutes Verständnis der Halbleiter-Gerätephysik, Eigenschaften und Technologieentwicklungsprozesse - Ausstellung einer funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Prozess-, Charakterisierungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsteams - Erste Erfahrung in der eigenen technischen

Descrizione L'opportunité Dans nos groupes de puces à semi-conducteurs BiMOS R&D chez Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, nous développons des dispositifs à semi-conducteurs de puissance de pointe dans plusieurs classes de tension. Nos produits de haute qualité sont fabriqués sur des sites de production internes et externes et livrés à des clients du monde entier dans une large gamme d'applications, y compris l'énergie industrielle, renouvelable, traction et e-mobilité. Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un spécialiste des puces semi-conducteurs de R-D motivé pour contribuer au développement de technologies de semi-conducteurs de nouvelle génération. Dans ce rôle, vous vous concentrerez sur les dispositifs à base de silicium (avec une forte exposition aux diodes de puissance) tout en vous étendant vers des concepts d'appareils plus larges tels que les IGBT et les MOSFET. Ce poste est idéal pour les candidats ayant une solide base technique en physique et simulation des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, qui sont désireux de développer leur expertise dans un environnement collaboratif de R-D de haute technologie. Combinez-vous une solide expérience technique en physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs avec une expérience pratique en simulation et en développement technologique? Êtes-vous motivé à prendre en charge les tâches de développement tout en apprenant et en augmentant continuellement? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature. Mansioni - Contribuer au développement de puces semi-conducteurs de nouvelle génération, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les diodes de puissance au silicium et les technologies connexes - Soutenir le cycle de développement de la technologie et des produits de bout en bout, du concept et de la simulation à l'évaluation de la validation et de la fiabilité - Appliquer et développer des modèles de simulation TCAD pour comprendre le comportement de l'appareil et optimiser les performances, le rendement et le coût - Collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieurs de process, les équipes de caractérisation et de fiabilité, en assurant l'alignement entre conception et fabrication - Prendre en charge les travaux individuels ou les sous-projets, contribuant ainsi aux objectifs et aux échéanciers globaux du projet - Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des méthodes d'analyse, de modélisation et d'optimisation fondées sur les données - Contribuer activement au partage des connaissances au sein de l'équipe et développer une solide compréhension au niveau des systèmes des dispositifs et procédés à semi-conducteurs
• Requisiti - Maîtrise ou doctorat en physique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe, mettant l'accent sur la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs - Expérience éprouvée dans le développement de dispositifs semi-conducteurs de puissance, idéalement avec l'exposition aux diodes de puissance en silicium - Forte expérience pratique avec les outils de simulation TCAD (par exemple Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Bonne compréhension de la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, des caractéristiques et des processus de développement technologique - Exposition à une collaboration interfonctionnelle avec des équipes de processus, de caractérisation et de fiabilité - L'expérience initiale dans la possession de tâches techniques ou la supervision de profils juniors est un plus - La connaissance des aspects d'intégration des processus ou des approches de modélisation est considérée comme un avantage - Autodidacte, analytique et désireux d'apprendre et de grandir dans un environnement de R-D performant - Maîtrise de l'anglais avec de solides compétences en communication et présentation Contatto

jobs.title: Senior Quality Expert – Composites Insulators High Voltage products (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role you drive excellence in quality, delivery, and compliance for the supply base. Furthermore, you ensure global processes are understood and implemented by the SCM network. As Senior Quality Expert – Composites Insulators, you will work closely with Hitachi Energy High Voltage Supply Chain, Technical Center, Group Product Service Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and the Global SCM team on all activity required to effectively support supplier quality requirements for assigned High Voltage commodities and suppliers. This position can be fulfilled remotely within Europe - please submit your documents in English. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute PPAP qualification plans, supplier audits, surveillance programs, and process\/product verification activities. Participate in supplier technical reviews, approval processes, and internal NPI (New Product Introduction) activities. Drive process quality improvements using Hitachi Energy tools, statistical methods, and CTQ evaluations. Conduct root‑cause analyses, FMEA, and corrective\/preventive actions to ensure sustainable process improvements. Reduce Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) based on customer and factory feedback, embedding CTQs in supplier processes. Support SQEs, Engineering, and suppliers by promoting industrial standards of excellence and best practices. Lead global activities for composites insulators, including Prior Failure Analysis (PFA) updates and special processes. Collaborate closely with Category teams to support CIPS strategies, supplier classification, selection, onboarding, and performance improvement. Your background Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical field (Master's degree preferred). 7+ years of experience in Supplier Quality or Manufacturing Process Quality, ideally for composite insulators. Strong knowledge of PPAP, APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and process capability tools. Proven auditing experience and familiarity with ISO 9001 \/ IATF 16949 quality standards. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including RCA and 8D methodologies. Demonstrated ability to work in cross‑functional and global teams with strong stakeholder interaction. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to manage complex technical discussions. Willingness to travel up to 40% globally and lead activities across international supplier networks. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we know that people thrive when they have flexibility, trust, and the space to grow. Our working practices are designed to support both personal and business performance, giving you the freedom to develop your skills and shape your career. Benefits vary by country, based on local practices and job grade. We'll be happy to share specific details during the interview process.

jobs.title: R&D and Production Engineering Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Business R&D team in Turgi, where we develop cutting-edge medium-voltage frequency converters and HVDC subsystems. You'll work in a collaborative environment with six power electronics engineers and three mechanical engineers, contributing to innovative solutions that have a global impact. This position combines 60% R&D and 40% production engineering, offering flexibility for research activities and hands-on involvement in manufacturing processes. How you'll make an impact   •  Research & Development (60%) Drive innovation in medium-voltage converter design and technology Develop and build from prototype until the final product Collaborate with global teams in Poland, Sweden, India and China Work arrangement: Flexible (remote or on-site as needed)   •  Production Engineering (40%) Ensure seamless integration of designs into manufacturing processes Optimize production workflows for efficiency and quality Provide technical support to production teams and troubleshoot issues Work arrangement: On-site presence required at our factories in Turgi and Seon Lead & implement lean management and CIP methodology   Your background   Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field Experience in power electronics and converter technology Experience in mechanical design and development, with tools like SolidEdge, NX, SAP Knowledge of production processes and industrialization Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Fluent in English and German   What We Offer Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. We also offer you: Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers Numerous exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Discounted conditions in our daycare centres in Baden and Oerlikon Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidized meals at locations with canteens Discounts on memberships at various fitness centers Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more

• Anforderungen Auslegung und Überprüfung von Prüfkreisen und Versuchsanordnungen sowie Auswahl geeigneter Messmittel Durchführung von Entwicklungs- und Typprüfungen im Hochstromlabor (thermisch und dielektrisch) Sorgfältige und vollständige Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse Zeitnahe und effiziente Erstellung von Prüfberichten Erfassung und Dokumentation der verrechenbaren Laborleistungen Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prüf- und Arbeitsprozessen im Team Kostenkalkulation von Prüfungen und Laborleistungen sowie Erstellung von Angeboten für internationale Kunden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektro- oder Energietechnik (FH oder Universität) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung Erste Berufserfahrung im Fachbereich von Vorteil Kenntnisse im Umgang mit verschiedenen Messgeräten und -verfahren Vorzugsweise Kenntnisse im Bereich elektrischer Kontakte Interesse an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Laborausrüstung und Prüfprozessen Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung mit Fokus auf Qualität und Effizienz Persönlichkeit mit guten organisatorischen Fähigkeiten Teamfähigkeit und hohe soziale Kompetenz Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy setzen wir auf Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und Innovation. Unsere Kultur fördert den offenen Austausch von Ideen, unterstützt individuelle Entwicklung und schafft ein Umfeld, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt und integriert werden. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft.

jobs.title: Global SCM Training Leader, BU Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Training Leader for the Business Unit Transformers to join our global training and supply chain community. In this role, you will define and drive the strategic direction, development, and deployment of Supply Chain Management (SCM) training programs across the business unit. You will play a key role in strengthening supply chain capabilities, enabling business performance, and supporting standardization, transformation, and continuous improvement across regions and functions. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of SCM capability development, work closely with global and regional stakeholders, and contribute to innovate, inspire and deliver transformative results in forward-thinking supply chain organization. How you`ll make an impact Define and implement the SCM training strategy and roadmap aligned with Business Unit supply chain priorities and transformation initiatives Design, develop, and deploy global SCM training programs, ensuring consistency, scalability, and operational relevance for global, regional and factory teams Establish specific KPIs to measure effectiveness, impact, and continuous improvement of learning initiatives in line with Hitachi Energy SCM functional and BU Training governance Collaborate with SCM leaders, Subject Matter Experts, and global\/regional stakeholders to identify capability gaps and ensure technical accuracy of training content Support the adoption of standardized SCM processes, tools, and best practices through structured learning solutions Drive a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing across the SCM community Promote innovative learning approaches and digital solutions to enhance engagement and learning effectiveness Your background Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field Minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Management, training, learning & development, or a related functional leadership role Proven experience in designing, deploying, and governing global training programs within complex, matrix organizations Strong understanding of end‑to‑end SCM processes, including sourcing, planning, logistics, supplier management, and sustainability Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across global and regional teams Analytical mindset with experience in defining KPIs, measuring training impact, and driving continuous improvement Digital and technology savviness in managing and executing training using modern digital and AI-enabled technologies Ability to work effectively in an international environment and manage multiple projects\/initiatives in parallel with proven track record of successfully managed projects
